info.name: BG2 - Unified Approvals Inbox + Global Audit Timeline
info.description:
BG2 collection. Covers the Unified Approvals Inbox aggregation/routing layer and the Global Audit Timeline read API. Mirrors AI_POSTMAN_WORKING_PATTERNS R1-R20 (canonical pre-request, dual-scope getVar/setVar, [200,201] login, /api/auth/me canonical context).

Locked rules verified:
- /api/auth/me remains canonical context source (R14).
- POST /api/auth/login accepts [200, 201] (R12).
- Inbox list routes through 6 wired domains: discount, refund, leave_request, shift_swap, vendor_bill, inter_branch_transfer (encoded as `${type}--${entityId}`).
- POST /api/approvals/:id/decide delegates to the underlying domain service (no double-write of business state).
- vendor_bill and refund expose APPROVE only (supportsReject=false) - REJECT returns 400.
- /api/audit/timeline is read-only; permission audit:read; filters via metadata.orgId and metadata.branchId JSON-path.
- Repeated decision returns 409.

item.name: README - variables, run order, locked rules

request.description:
Run folders in order:
A. Auth & Context Baseline
B. Approval Fixture (POS) - creates an order + large discount that becomes PENDING (M12 threshold).
C. Unified Approvals - List - status filters, sourceType filter, invalid sourceType -> 400.
D. Unified Approvals - Detail - GET /api/approvals/:id, malformed id -> 400, unknown id -> 404.
E. Unified Approvals - Decide REJECT - 200, repeat -> 409.
F. Unified Approvals - Decide APPROVE - second discount, 200.
G. Audit Timeline - actionPrefix=UNIFIED_APPROVAL_, exact action filter, dateFrom filter.

Wired source types (6): discount, refund, leave_request, shift_swap, vendor_bill, inter_branch_transfer.
Excluded (no native approval workflow): order voids, post-close voids, purchase orders.
REJECT not supported by underlying service: refund, vendor_bill (returns 400 with 'reject not supported').

Auto-populated variables: bg2Suffix, accessToken, orgId, branchId, menuItemId, orderId, discountId, approvalId, orderIdSecond, discountIdSecond, approvalIdSecond.
